verdict.rationale: Skyvern's core product is an in-product AI agent: users describe a goal in natural language with a URL, and it runs the browser work for them (docs-18, docs-31, docs-33). The dashboard also runs tasks (docs-3), and a built-in Copilot chat at app.skyvern.com builds, tests and debugs agents from a plain-English job description (docs-25, docs-29). Hands-on community testing shows it handles the happy path but struggled on an unfamiliar site (comm-2), which is a reliability caveat rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Copilot assistant's delegation capabilities, and independent corroboration of reliable task completion beyond happy paths.
